name: peekachu-rca-platform
description: Peekachu RCA Platform - One command runner for Frontend, Backend, Go RCA Engine & LibreChat Docker

scripts.start: npm run docker:up && npm run dev
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "ENGINE,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta.bold,cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.docker:up: cd LibreChat && docker compose -f deploy-compose.yml -f docker-compose.override.yml up -d
